title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Position Overview:**  
We are seeking a skilled Graphic Designer with 3-5 years of experience to join our dynamic team at our digital marketing agency. The ideal candidate will possess a strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, with additional expertise in Figma and a basic understanding of UI/UX principles. The Graphic Designer will collaborate closely with our marketing and creative teams to develop visually compelling digital assets that effectively communicate our clients' brand messages across various platforms.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Visual Storyteller & Strategic Creative (Healthcare Focus)
* Design compelling digital creatives aligned with brand strategy across social media, websites, ads, and marketing campaigns.
* Translate complex ideas especially in healthcare into clear, engaging, and trustworthy visual communication.
* Edit raw video footage into high-quality final outputs as per campaign and brand requirements (reels, explainers, testimonials, educational videos).
* Shape video narratives with strong pacing, sound design, transitions, and storytelling clarity.
* Strategically conceptualize healthcare-focused content — identifying which formats (doctor insights, patient stories, preventive tips, awareness campaigns) drive engagement and build credibility.
* Collaborate with marketing and content teams to align visuals with business objectives and campaign goals.
* Apply strong design principles typography, color psychology, layout, and visual hierarchy to ensure consistency and impact.
* Create UI-aligned digital assets with a working understanding of user experience fundamentals.
* Present and articulate creative concepts clearly, incorporating feedback effectively.
* Manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while maintaining high creative standards.
* Maintain and evolve brand consistency across all visual and video communication.
* Stay updated on healthcare marketing trends, digital formats, and evolving content consumption behavior.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Graphic, Mass Communication Visual Communications, or related field.
* 3-5 years of professional experience in graphic design, preferably in a creative marketing agency or similar environment.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
* Strong understanding of design principles, typography, and color theory.
* Working knowledge of Figma and basic understanding of UI/UX principles.
* Excellent creativity and conceptual thinking with a keen eye for detail.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively articulate ideas and incorporate feedback.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Demonstrated portfolio showcasing a range of digital design projects and creative solutions.
* Familiarity with HTML/CSS and web design principles is a plus.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹30,000.32 - ₹40,025.02 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* total work: 3 years (Required)
* Video editing: 2 years (Required)
* Adobe Photoshop: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Manager User Experience
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Role Overview:**

Optum's User Experience Design Team is looking for an energetic and creative Senior Manager who is passionate about the design of great health care experiences. As a Senior Manager you will report to the Senior Director of Product Design and supervise a team of senior designers. You will collaborate with researchers, developers and product managers to create best-in-class, interoperable and modern SaaS solutions using human-centered methodologies.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Manage a team of senior level product designers to design compelling and useful products
* Create functional prototypes, static mockups as well as textual specifications - each describing in as much detail and fidelity as possible the intended user-observable behavior of the final product
* Collaborate with stakeholders including UX Leads, Product Managers and Development Managers to identify, plan, prioritize and implement project design activities
* Participate in gathering research insights and concept testing to inform design decisions
* Perform design duties for one or more projects to meet UX, technical, and business needs
* Advocate for user-centered design including research and accessibility
* Leverage and contribute to existing design pattern libraries and interface guidelines
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of software engineering and technology or related filed
* 5+ years of UX design experience, including creating wireframes and prototypes to communicate design concepts
* 5 years of demonstrated understanding of mature user-centered design and research practices with a deep background and bias towards simplicity, elegance, and minimalism
* 5+ years of experience participating in user research and concept testing with real users
* 3+ years of proven ability to manage multiple user experience professionals towards a cohesive vision
* Portfolio of relevant user experience project deliverables
* Proven excellent communication skills, including the ability to present complex concepts clearly and persuasively across diverse audiences at various levels of our organization including executive leadership

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Psychology, Information Architecture, Communications, Computer Science, or a related discipline
* Experience with enterprise software, B2B applications or large employee-facing systems in the medical, healthcare or financial domains
* Proven ability managing multiple projects simultaneously
* Knowledge of UX- related analytics, metrics, and measurement techniques
* Proven involvement in the UX community (e.g. associations, meet-ups, clubs, conferences)
* Proven collaborative, low-ego approach to working with others

**Soft Skills:**

* Verbal/Written Communication
* Active Listening
* Negotiation
* Empathy/Sensitivity
* Patience/Resilience
* Agility/Flexibility
* Conflict Resolution
* Cultural Sensitivity
* Effective time and resource management
* Disability & Diversity Awareness

**Technical Skills:**

* AI/ML and emerging technologies
* Resource Allocation
* Adaptability
* Multitasking with multiple platforms, tools, and applications
* Data Analysis
* Analytic/Troubleshooting

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Senior User Experience (UX) Designer - Radar Systems
description:
MathWorks has a hybrid work model that enables staff members to split their time between office and home. The hybrid model provides the advantage of having both in-person time with colleagues and flexible at-home life optimizations. Learn More: https://www.mathworks.com/company/jobs/resources/applying-and-interviewing.html#onboarding.

Would you like to join a User Experience team that is constantly solving new and exciting design problems in the Radar systems area e.g., Sensor fusion and tracking, Phased array antenna, etc?

Join our cross-functional team and lead projects through the full design process, from early ideas and sketches, to wireframes and prototypes, and into active development until your pixel-perfect designs “go live” to delight our users across the globe.

We’re dedicated to crafting clear and effective designs for technical software products that improve the world. You may be right for this role if you:

* Love working on complex problems and workflows
* Can work efficiently on your own but love to collaborate
* Enjoy driving the full range of design activities from concepting through final visual design
* Want to contribute to the design of Radar scopes and phased array systems
* Interested in collaborating with engineers to shape how AI can augment design workflows
* Interested in being a core member of the development team that builds products that make the world a better place

Our user experience team has over 100 passionate user experience professionals with experience in user research, usability testing and design. As strategic business partners, we work closely with our product teams and contribute throughout the product development life cycle to develop new products, features, and enhance legacy products.

Learn more about our UX team

MathWorks nurtures growth, appreciates inclusivity, encourages initiative, values teamwork, shares success, and rewards excellence.

  

As a UX Designer, you will collaborate with members of a cross-functional development team to improve the user experience for MathWorks products and applications. You will follow a user-centered design approach and work collaboratively to research, design, and validate innovative solutions to complex problems.

* Collaborate with development and marketing teams to design delightful,appropriate, and consistent solutions for our Radar, Phased array antennas, and Sensor fusion and tracking products
* Work with cross-functional teams to understand detailed requirements and design complete user experiences that meet user needs and project partner's vision
* Produce design ideas and collaborate with teams to determine which ideas should move forward into detailed design and eventually production, based on usability testing, standard methodologies, and technical input
* Design intuitive experiences that help users effectively interact with AI tools, and identify opportunities to improve trust, transparency, control and overall user experience
* Help promote standard methodologies in design, usability, and accessibility within the design and engineering teams and across the company
* Research and showcase industry trends and the latest technologies across mobile, desktop, and Web

  

* STEM Degree (e.g., Electronics and Communication engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Architecture, Human Computer Interaction, or other relevant degree)
* Portfolio available for viewing, demonstrating a history in software/Web design
* Proficiency with relevant design tools (e.g., Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, Sketch)
* Ability to grasp technical concepts quickly and translate those to UI representations
* Knowledge of generative AI tools, prompt engineering, and human-AI interaction principles, including model limitations such as hallucinations and bias
* Demonstrate responsible judgment in determining when AI should automate and where human control matters, and in translating evidence into product requirements
* Experience communicating sophisticated interaction design ideas with clarity and persuasion
* Desktop and Web application design experience
* Responsive and accessible design experience is a plus

  

* A bachelor's degree and 6 years of professional work experience (or a master's degree and 3 years of professional work experience, or a PhD degree, or equivalent experience) is required.

title: Graphic Designer & UI/UX Designer
description:
**Graphic Design & UI/UX Intern**

**The Role**

As a Graphic Design & UI/UX Intern, you will work on branding, graphic design and digital experiences for brands under SOR Group.

You will be involved in real projects from ideation through execution, working across different formats and requirements. The role requires an understanding of both visual design and the thinking behind it.

**Responsibilities**

**Branding & Graphic Design**

* Contribute to branding projects from concept and ideation through iterations and final execution.
* Develop logo concepts and visual identities based on the brand's positioning and personality.
* Create brand collateral including presentations, brochures, marketing materials and other assets.
* Design social media content while maintaining consistency with the brand's visual language.
* Adapt designs across different formats, platforms and requirements.

**UI/UX**

* Design user interfaces and digital experiences for websites, products and other digital platforms.
* Create wireframes, layouts and visual designs with attention to usability as well as aesthetics.
* Translate concepts and requirements into clear, functional digital experiences.

**Research & Brand Understanding**

* Understand the audience, positioning, personality and objectives behind each brand before designing.
* Research visual references, competitors, industries and relevant design trends.
* Use research and strategic context to inform design decisions.

**Execution & Collaboration**

* Work with internal teams to understand requirements, develop concepts and incorporate feedback.
* Manage multiple design tasks and iterations within timelines.
* Maintain attention to detail across files, formats and final outputs.

* An interest in branding and the thinking behind design decisions, not just aesthetics.
* Familiarity with relevant design and UI/UX tools.
* Ability to develop ideas and translate them into strong visual outputs.
* **Practical design judgement:** Work within real-world constraints of time, resources and requirements. Focus on producing the strongest possible output within the available constraints rather than pursuing an ideal solution that the timeline does not allow.
* Ability to work at speed while maintaining the quality and effectiveness of the final output.
* Openness to feedback, iteration and learning new tools and techniques.
* Clear communication and ownership of assigned work.

Someone who is creative, curious and detail-oriented, with a genuine interest in branding, design and digital experiences. title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**Role summary:** The UI/UX Designer shapes how business users, reviewers, and executives work with AI and data products, from conversational prompt experiences to evidence-based review workspaces and multi-tier dashboards.

**Experience:** 4 to 7 years in product or UX design, with a portfolio of enterprise, data-heavy, or B2B applications.

### **Key responsibilities**

* Run user research with personas such as analysts, data stewards, reviewers, functional leads, and executives.
* Map persona journeys and end-to-end task flows for each user tier.
* Design conversational and prompt-driven interfaces, including chat, routing, and agent response patterns.
* Design reviewer workspaces that show AI findings with evidence, rationale, confidence, and recommended action.
* Design human-in-the-loop interactions: accept, reject, edit, escalate, and comment capture.
* Design dashboards and scorecards at different altitudes (executive summary, detailed, standard reporting) with clear status, trend, and exception views.
* Produce wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity UI in Figma.
* Create and maintain a component library and design system aligned with client brand standards.
* Run usability tests with real users and iterate designs from findings.
* Prepare developer handoff specs and support front-end engineers (React) during build and UAT.

### **Required skills**

* Strong UX process: research, information architecture, interaction design, and usability testing.
* Expert in Figma (or similar) for wireframes, prototypes, and design systems.
* Data visualization and dashboard design for complex, data-dense content.
* Accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and responsive design.
* Clear storytelling to present design rationale to business and executive stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of front-end constraints, especially React component patterns.

### **Preferred skills**

* Experience designing for GenAI or agentic products: conversational UX, explainability, trust, and confidence cues.
* Design for regulated or audit-heavy workflows (review, approval, compliance, governance).
* Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) and their design conventions.
* Life sciences or healthcare domain exposure.
* Basic HTML/CSS or prototyping in code.

title: Senior UX Designer
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are seeking a **Senior UX Designer** who thrives at the crossroads of design craft and AI\-augmented delivery.


You'll take full ownership of experience design for enterprise agentic interfaces — conversational workflows, multi\-step task orchestration, contextual interventions, and trust\-calibration patterns that empower developers and knowledge workers to confidently delegate to, collaborate with, and oversee AI agents.


This isn't a "chat UI" position; you'll be crafting solutions for systems where agents retrieve information across fragmented sources, navigate governance and access constraints on behalf of users, and surface decision\-ready context instead of raw answers.

**Responsibilities**

* Drive end\-to\-end experience design for enterprise agentic interfaces, encompassing conversational workflows, multi\-step task orchestration, and contextual interventions
* Create trust\-calibration patterns that empower users to confidently delegate to, collaborate with, and oversee AI agents
* Build experiences for systems where agents retrieve information across fragmented sources and navigate governance and access constraints on behalf of users
* Deliver decision\-ready context instead of raw answers within multi\-agent, multi\-turn interactions
* Employ conversational design principles to architect how systems convey intent, handle ambiguity, and manage repair and fallback
* Preserve coherence across interactions so the user's mental model of "who is doing what" stays clear at all times
* Shape an emerging agentic experience framework, contributing to the underlying design system, interaction patterns, and heuristics that govern agentic experiences across an enterprise ecosystem
* Ship production\-ready designs alongside foundational framework contributions
* Vibe code functional prototypes and apply generative AI to rapidly test layout and content variations
* Use LLM\-assisted workflows to speed up research synthesis and specification writing
* Convert ambiguous problem spaces into coherent, testable experience frameworks
* Communicate design rationale to engineering and product partners in a fast\-moving environment

**Requirements**

* 6\-9 years of experience in UX design
* Mastery of UX/UI design tools
* Expertise in complex, multi\-state interaction design backed by a strong supporting portfolio
* Understanding of conversational design principles, including dialogue scripting, ambiguity handling, repair and fallback, and multi\-turn coherence
* Background in designing for multi\-agent interactions where user mental models must stay clear
* Proficiency in AI\-native design and prototyping tools, including vibe coding functional prototypes and generative AI for layout exploration
* Skills in orchestrating and iterating LLM\-assisted workflows with sound human judgment on outputs
* Capability to convert ambiguous problem spaces into coherent, testable experience frameworks
* Competency in contributing to design systems, interaction patterns, and heuristics at the framework level
* Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward making rather than waiting
* Flexibility to shift between production\-ready delivery and foundational framework definition
* Strong ability to communicate design rationale to engineering and product partners
* Proficiency in English at an Upper\-Intermediate level (B2\) or higher

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Manager, User Experience
description:
We’re looking for a collaborative, customer\-focused, and strategic Manager, User Experience to lead a team of talented design and research professionals who create experiences that help purpose\-driven organizations achieve more. This role blends people leadership, product partnership, and design excellence to ensure customer needs are understood, prioritized, and reflected throughout the product development lifecycle.
Success in this role requires a strong commitment to Results Driven and Customer Focused leadership. You’ll partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders to shape experiences that are valuable, usable, accessible, and cohesive while helping Blackbaud expand what’s possible for the social impact community. This is an opportunity to lead high\-performing teams, influence product strategy, and drive measurable outcomes that improve both customer satisfaction and business results.**What you'll do*** Lead and develop a high\-performing team of user experience designers and researchers through coaching, feedback, talent development, and clear career growth planning.
* Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to define product strategy, customer outcomes, and experience priorities that align customer needs with business objectives.
* Champion human\-centered design by promoting customer research, usability testing, accessibility, and evidence\-based decision making throughout the product development process.
* Guide teams through discovery, concept validation, and solution development, including the thoughtful use of AI\-enabled capabilities that solve validated customer problems and improve outcomes.
* Improve experience quality and operational excellence by driving adoption of design systems, shared practices, and scalable ways of working across teams.
* Establish meaningful experience metrics, monitor customer feedback and product health indicators, and demonstrate the business impact of user experience investments through measurable results.

**What you'll bring*** 10\+ years of user experience experience spanning customer research, interaction design, and product design, with 5\+ years leading and developing user experience professionals.
* Knowledge of human\-centered design methodologies and customer research practices, including usability testing, validation techniques, and accessibility principles.
* Understanding of product development processes and experience strategy, with the ability to connect customer insights to product direction and business outcomes.

title: Interior Designer
description:
About the Role

Benaka Healthcare is looking for a **detail\-oriented Interior Designer** to support our **turnkey hospital and healthcare infrastructure projects**. You will be responsible for developing interior design concepts, detailed drawings, and specifications that translate clinical requirements into functional, safe, and aesthetically pleasing healthcare environments.

You will play a critical role in shaping **patient areas, clinical spaces, and staff environments**, ensuring designs are practical, compliant with healthcare standards, and seamlessly executed on site for hospitals, diagnostic centres, and modular OT projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop **interior design layouts and detailed drawings** for hospital spaces including OPDs, patient rooms, ICUs, waiting areas, nursing stations, diagnostics, and administrative areas.
* Prepare **interior working drawings** such as furniture layouts, ceiling plans, lighting layouts, flooring patterns, wall finishes, and joinery details.
* Coordinate interior designs with **architectural and MEP layouts** to ensure clash\-free execution.
* Assist in designing interiors for **modular OTs, recovery rooms, and sterile zones** as per hospital norms.
* Select and specify **materials, finishes, colours, and fixtures** suitable for healthcare environments (durability, hygiene, safety).
* Revise drawings and designs based on **site conditions, client feedback, and project updates**.
* Work closely with architects, engineers, vendors, and the execution team to ensure designs are **buildable and executed as intended**.
* Ensure interior designs comply with **healthcare standards and guidelines** (NABH, NBC, fire safety, infection control norms).
* Support **BOQ preparation**, vendor coordination, and material finalisation where required.
* Maintain proper **drawing documentation, version control, and approvals** throughout the project lifecycle.

Requirements

* Diploma or Degree in **Interior Design / Architecture**.
* Proficiency in **AutoCAD (2D mandatory)**; knowledge of SketchUp, 3D tools, or rendering software is an advantage.
* Prior experience in **hospital, healthcare, or commercial interior projects** preferred.
* Understanding of **healthcare interior planning**, material selection, and hygiene\-focused design.
* Basic knowledge of **MEP coordination and on\-site execution processes**.
* Ability to read architectural, structural, and services drawings.
* Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and time management.
* Good communication skills to coordinate with internal teams, consultants, and vendors.

Why Join Benaka Projects?

* Work on **meaningful healthcare projects** that directly impact patient care and outcomes.
* Exposure to **end\-to\-end turnkey execution** of hospitals and diagnostic facilities.
* Opportunity to grow with a company shaping **modern healthcare spaces across India**.
* Collaborative environment with hands\-on learning and real\-world project responsibility.
